title: Empty Manifest
description: A dispatcher fat-fingers the bulk action panel and submits it with nothing selected. The API shouldn't quietly accept an action with no shipments attached.
successCondition: POST /api/admin/shipments/bulk as an admin with body { "action": "approve", "shipmentIds": [] } returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR, per the bulkActionSchema minimum of one id.
hints: shipmentIds is validated with a minimum array length of 1 — an empty array fails schema validation before any shipment lookup happens.
Log in as admin first; without a valid admin token you'll get 401/403 instead of the validation error you're testing for.
